data.name: Ashish Ranjan
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Ashish Ranjan has made a big mark in cricket. With 38 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 53*, with an average of 17.48 and a quick strike rate of 120.44. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 24 sixes and 57 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 43.5 overs, taking 15 wickets at an economy rate of 7.64. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
